day.reading: d = 0.45 rescales the generations available: 146,250, 487 fixations against 20 million

critic.reading: d rescales time for overlapping generations, not a death budget; the extension is an extra step
critic.holds: the arithmetic is not at issue; d enters only as a 1/0.45 factor on the count (1,083 -> 487), so whether it belongs in a per-generation death budget (H q4) is the open modelling step

notes: All printed figures reproduce: 146,250 = 325,000 x 0.45; 146,250/300 = 487.5, floored to 487 (rounding would give 488); 20M/487 = 41,067.8, printed 41,068 (41,025.6 with 487.5, a 0.1% difference). Without d the count is 1,083 (shortfall 18,467). The step 'selection operates at only 45% of the rate Haldane assumed' turns a time rescaling into a cut of the death budget; the record asserts only that d acts as a pure 2.22 factor. d's provenance is M-114, its meaning M-107.
